name: arrows-legend-bi
description: Arrows Master BI dashboard (monorepo with Unity game)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.setup:server: python3 -m venv server/.venv && server/.venv/bin/pip install -r server/requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:server && npm install --prefix web && npm install
